policy: Compute pressure-dependent exit speed v=v0*sqrt(relativePressure), mass-flow area=aperture*v, gravity, quadratic drag opposing velocity and equal/opposite short-range cohesive/viscous forces in a fixed-step 2D particle approximation. These are normalized art solver units and authored preview floor segments, not measured ink or a full incompressible Navier-Stokes solve. Preserve source body pixels; extend the held pose until all visible ink has drained, then play the original700ms retraction. Keep emission650ms and expose the post-emission visual drain separately; do not add damage or residual puddles. H3's27-key charge is approved and copied byte-for-byte. No Unity/combat integration or collider sizes are finalized.
